params.name: AccountSID
params.description: Unique identifier for the partner account.

params.name: ProgramId
params.description: Unique identifier for the brand program the tracking link is for.

params.name: Type
params.description:
The type of tracking link to generate.

- `Regular`: System-generated short link.
- `Vanity`: Branded link with a custom path (requires `CustomPath`).

params.name: CustomPath
params.description: Custom path that follows the tracking domain (e.g., `SummerSale` produces `https://example.sjv.io/SummerSale`). Required when `Type=Vanity`. If omitted on a vanity link, a random path is generated.

params.name: AdId
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad to deep-link into (see the Partner Ads API). If omitted, the tracking link redirects to the brand's default landing page.

params.name: DeepLink
params.description: The exact destination URL the tracking link should redirect to after attribution. Use this to send clicks to a specific product page instead of the brand's default landing page.

params.name: MediaPartnerPropertyId
params.description: Unique identifier of the media property (website, social profile, or app) where the link will be used. See the Partner Media Properties API.

params.name: subId1
params.description: Sub-affiliate identifier surfaced as a column in partner performance reports. Use to segment traffic by your own categories.

params.name: subId2
params.description: Additional sub-affiliate identifier surfaced as a column in partner performance reports.

params.name: subId3
params.description: Additional sub-affiliate identifier surfaced as a column in partner performance reports.

params.name: sharedId
params.description: Shared identifier surfaced as a column in partner performance reports.

items.docs: Generates a new tracking link for the specified program. Up to **5,000 vanity links** can exist on an account — exceeding that limit returns a 403 Forbidden response.
